ledger_accounts_owner.name: ledger_accounts_owner
ledger_accounts_owner.value: ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'user' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'house' AND "ledger_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL)

bets_settled_amounts.name: bets_settled_amounts
bets_settled_amounts.value: ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'void', 'cashed_out') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NOT NULL AND "bets"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("bets"."status" NOT IN ('pending_acceptance', 'open', 'rejected') OR ("bets"."settled_gross_payout" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_tax" IS NULL AND "bets"."settled_net_payout" IS NULL))

payment_intents_poll_idx.name: payment_intents_poll_idx
payment_intents_poll_idx.where: "payment_intents"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired') AND "payment_intents"."flagged_at" IS NULL AND "payment_intents"."provider_ref" IS NOT NULL

jackpot_entries_prize.name: jackpot_entries_prize
jackpot_entries_prize.value: ("jackpot_entries"."status" = 'open' AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_gross" IS NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax" IS NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" IS NULL) OR ("jackpot_entries"."status" <> 'open' AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax" >= 0 AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" >= 0 AND "jackpot_entries"."prize_gross" = "jackpot_entries"."prize_net" + "jackpot_entries"."prize_tax")

jackpot_entries_correct.name: jackpot_entries_correct
jackpot_entries_correct.value: ("jackpot_entries"."status" IN ('won', 'lost')) = ("jackpot_entries"."correct" IS NOT NULL AND "jackpot_entries"."best_correct" IS NOT NULL)

jackpot_rounds_final.name: jackpot_rounds_final
jackpot_rounds_final.value: ("jackpot_rounds"."status" IN ('settled', 'cancelled')) = ("jackpot_rounds"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jackpot_rounds"."settlement" IS NOT NULL)

daily_summaries_final.name: daily_summaries_final
daily_summaries_final.value: ("daily_summaries"."status" = 'final') = ("daily_summaries"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "daily_summaries"."finalized_by" IS NOT NULL)

daily_summaries_commission.name: daily_summaries_commission
daily_summaries_commission.value: "daily_summaries"."commission_rate_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "daily_summaries"."commission_due" >= 0 AND ("daily_summaries"."ggr" > 0 OR "daily_summaries"."commission_due" = 0) AND "daily_summaries"."commission_due" <= GREATEST("daily_summaries"."ggr", 0)
